decisions.claim: 1976 original audiovisual speech mismatch
decisions.disposition: Hearing a fusion syllable under mismatched dubbed mouth and audio; not universal.

decisions.claim: Some subjects report a third syllable absent from isolated audio
decisions.disposition: Report only under specific conditions; do not fabricate a test.

decisions.claim: McGurk is a universal 100% illusion
decisions.disposition: Study shows strong participant and stimulus variability.

decisions.claim: Slower playback increases illusion incidence
decisions.disposition: 2019 110-person study reports lower occurrence with slowdown.

decisions.claim: 2019 study included 110 subjects
decisions.disposition: Experimental sample; not Zen12 sample.

decisions.claim: Individual effect ranged from 0 to 100% in tested conditions
decisions.disposition: Not a population prevalence estimate.

decisions.claim: McGurk responses diagnose suggestibility or neurodivergence
decisions.disposition: No diagnosis or personality inference from one clip.

decisions.claim: Group-difference significance filtering can inflate reported effect
decisions.disposition: Analytic bias finding, does not invalidate original sensory phenomenon.

decisions.claim: Exact McGurk experimental stimulus is shown in our film
decisions.disposition: Film is a silent original explanatory illustration; never call it a demonstration.

decisions.claim: McGurk proves meditation audio reprograms the brain
decisions.disposition: The McGurk study tests audiovisual speech, not commercial audio.

decisions.claim: The historical Puységur record proves magnetic fluid
decisions.disposition: Use only as historical contextual source; original causal claim not proven.

decisions.claim: Puységur comparison is methodological not mechanism equivalence
decisions.disposition: Separate testimony, mechanism and controls.

decisions.claim: Zen12 sessions are described as 12 minutes
decisions.disposition: Current public seller description.

decisions.claim: Zen12 advertises 12 levels
decisions.disposition: Year-long progression merchant representation.

decisions.claim: Zen12 advertises four listening formats
decisions.disposition: Relaxation music, guided, nature, white noise.

decisions.claim: Complete Zen12 library advertises 48 MP3s

decisions.claim: Smaller Zen12 tiers advertise six levels and 24 MP3s

decisions.claim: 12 minutes equals one hour of advanced meditation

decisions.claim: Zen12 automatically puts brain in prescribed waves
decisions.disposition: EEG literature mixed; no product trial establishing outcome.

decisions.claim: All binaural beat EEG literature confirms entrainment

decisions.claim: Zen12 cures anxiety, insomnia or mental illness
decisions.disposition: Do not imply clinical treatment or medical guarantees.

decisions.claim: Zen12 guarantees creativity or financial success

decisions.claim: Broader meditation findings prove Zen12
